reuse.why: Builds on the existing applyWeekendRule/WeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend abstraction for moves and holidays, and adds shared isDailyWeekendSkip/isWeekendOrHoliday predicates, but the daily-skip selection is not folded into a shared occurrence function.

duplication.why: The occurrences -> filter daily weekend/holiday skip -> applyWeekendRule -> dayFromDate pipeline is written twice in schedules/app.ts (getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange), with a third variant (getWeekdayOccurrence) in shared/schedules.ts, each with its own over-fetch heuristic.

placement.why: Holiday and weekend rules live in shared/schedules.ts; the daily-skip orchestration is spread into the server handlers rather than kept with the rule.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; a stray change adds async to two describe callbacks in app.test.ts.

maintainability.why: Holiday handling flows through one function, but the skip-for-daily logic and its lookahead/margin heuristics must be kept consistent across three places, and getNextDate's daily branch ignores its noSkipWeekend flag.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily skip + weekend rule pipeline repeated in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) and reshaped as getWeekdayOccurrence in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays added to WeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend; getNextDate gains an isDailyWeekendSkip early-return branch that bypasses noSkipWeekend; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange each implement the daily skip filter themselves rather than through a shared function.
